metadata.description: BioQuill top bar configuration — platform header and PDF report header

brand.name: BiOQUILL
brand.tagline_line1: Know the odds. Understand the pipeline.

platform_topbar.description: Sticky top bar shown on all platform pages. Replaces current navigation header.

logo_section.description: Logo circle overflows bar top and bottom — vertically centered on bar midpoint

tagline_section.description: Two-line tagline immediately right of wordmark, vertically centered
tagline_section.note: Hide tagline in platform topbar — space constrained. Show only in PDF header.

right_section.description: Data refresh date pushed to far right

nav_links.description: Navigation links centered in the bar

pdf_header.description: Header bar for all generated PDF due diligence reports. Full width of page.

tagline_section.description: Two-line tagline shown in PDF header, immediately right of wordmark
tagline_section.line1: Know the odds. Understand the pipeline.

right_section.description: Data refresh date at far right — maximally spaced from tagline
right_section.label: Data refreshed:

platform: Add margin-top: 48px to all page content wrappers so content isn't hidden behind fixed bar
The current dark navy nav bar should be REPLACED by this yellow bar — do not stack them
Nav links (Platform, Methodology, Strategy Hub, Pricing, Search) move into this bar, centered
Logo circle uses overflow: visible so it bleeds 4px above and below the 48px bar
The emblem PNG/SVG should be the flame-feather icon only (no background) placed inside the black circle
pdf: Replace the current yellow bar in PDFs — current version has wrong proportions and missing tagline
Bar must span full page width with no left/right margin
Logo circle overflows bar by ~1.5mm top and bottom
Tagline and data-refreshed date must be on the same horizontal line as the wordmark
Data-refreshed date should be pushed to the absolute right edge (margin-left: auto)
This header should appear on EVERY page of the PDF, not just page 1
Use @page or repeating header technique in PDF generator

colors.note: Use #F5C518 consistently — do not use the slightly different yellow currently in some PDF headers
